0.0: I still can't believe it. #p1010100# kept saying #p1013103#'s second son was stronger than other explorers. But seeing you now, they must be nothing but rumors.#b\r\n#L0##bWhat? I'm super strong!#l\n#k
0.1: You may have spent your time chasing a few monsters instead of helping out at the farm, but I need a competent adventurer. If you really are capable, prove your strength to me. Why don't I give you a little test?

yes.0: Are you? Then #b20 #o2220100#s#k should be nothing for you. I have nothing else to say to you until you bring back proof of your deeds.\r\nWhat, #t4000009#? Pfft, too easy. I'll bring back a #bBlue Mushroom Doll#k!

no.0: Stop wasting time trying to be someone you're not and go help your father at the farm. You...? An adventurer...? HA!

1.0: Hm... You really got it. Fine, maybe you are more competent that I thought. A #o2220100# is no pushover, after all. Still, I don't know if I can trust you.\r\n#L0##bOh, come ON! How much junk do I have to bring you?#l\n#k
1.1: Let me think about it a little longer.

item.0: Haven't you found the #bBlue Mushroom Doll#k yet? Stop wasting your time and mine and just give up.
